name: Clara Oswald
oracle_text:
Impossible Girl — If Clara Oswald is your commander, choose a color before the game begins. Clara Oswald is the chosen color.
If a triggered ability of a Doctor you control triggers, that ability triggers an additional time.
Doctor's companion (You can have two commanders if the other is the Doctor.)
blocked_sentences: Impossible Girl — If Clara Oswald is your commander, choose a color before the game begins. Clara Oswald is the chosen color.
Doctor's companion (You can have two commanders if the other is the Doctor.)

needs.what: a pregame decision for a card that is its owner's commander: before the game begins its owner chooses a color, and the card is that color in every zone for the rest of the game (a characteristic-defining color set from a game-start choice, conditional on being a commander)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `choose_color` is an op that runs only when an ability or spell resolves, and `set_colors` is a static whose colors are printed; nothing runs before the game begins, nothing records a per-card chosen color the static could read, and `is_commander` only filters, it does not trigger a choice

needs.what: the Doctor's companion deckbuilding keyword: a legendary creature with it may be a second commander when the other commander is a Time Lord Doctor creature
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The keyword list carries only `partner` and `choose_a_background` as two-commander permissions; partner pairs any two partners and choose_a_background pairs with a Background, neither of which is the Doctor/companion pairing
